architecture.name: QROS_FAST_RESEARCH_V2_MEMORY_ISOLATED_MAP_REDUCE
architecture.technical_segment_rule: Each structural state runs in a disposable process and emits only deterministic fixed-record class-occurrence and alias logs. No selection, gate decision, economic read, or scientific interpretation occurs per segment.
architecture.global_reduction_rule: Only the complete 24-segment deterministic reduction is eligible for scientific parity comparison.
architecture.storage_hot_path: append-only fixed-record logs; no random SQLite alias/class updates
architecture.memory_rule: process lifetime is bounded by one structural state; process exit is the working-set reclamation boundary
architecture.semantic_dedupe_rule: family-mask equivalence is deduplicated before pair intersections; final mask identity remains exact ordered uint64 source-record coordinates

adversarial_eliminations: ACID relaxation alone: insufficient for full-domain completion
raw uncompressed mask storage: rejected due I/O amplification
madvise per carrier: rejected due repeated tick-page refault
single long-lived process: rejected due cumulative working-set pressure
golden-only shortcut: rejected because semantic and full-alias roots require complete global mapping

local_validation_artifacts.note: Heavy local validation artifacts were not promoted as scientific authority; exact global roots and frozen input identities are the scientific evidence.
